Up to which FeynHiggs release (version number) do the updates described in the paper go? Please tell me where you found it.

Weigleina aDESY, Notkestraße 85, D–22607 Hamburg, Germany bMax-Planck-Institut für Physik, Föhringer Ring 6, D–80805 Munich, Germany cInstituto de Física Teórica, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid Cantoblanco, 28049 Madrid, Spain; Campus of International Excellence UAM+CSIC, Cantoblanco, 28049, Madrid, Spain; Instituto de Física de Cantabria (CSIC-UC), E–39005 Santander, Spain dSorbonne Université, CNRS, Laboratoire de Physique Théorique et Hautes Énergies (LPTHE), 4 Place Jussieu, F–75252 Paris CEDEX 05, France eCP3-Origins, University of Southern Denmark, Odense, Denmark Abstract We present an overview of the status and recent developments of FeynHiggs (current version: 2.14.3) since version 2.12.2. The main purpose of FeynHiggs is the calculation of the Higgs-boson masses and other physical observables in the MSSM. For a precise prediction of the Higgs-boson masses for low and high SUSY scales, state-of-the-art ﬁxed-order and eﬀective-ﬁeld-theory calculations are combined. We ﬁrst discuss im- provements of the ﬁxed-order calculation, namely an optionalDR renormalization of the stop sector and a renormalization of the Higgs sector ensuring the chosen input mass
